title: Publish offline Mock-only DAILY HTML preview
prohibited_actions: No HTTP request, ObserverOS API, database, credential, media, deployment, analytics, or external asset
No business value, task, reminder, alert, queue, person, customer, appointment, work-order, financial, or raw-source fixture
No business calculation, local priority decision, permission decision, AI result, or authoritative status
No modification of existing React page, proposed interface schema, or ObserverOS repository
acceptance: A single offline HTML preview visibly presents the already-completed DAILY shell: header, navigation, anchored task area, four-module order shell, and four summary slots
Every information-bearing area is explicitly Mock-only and empty, and identifies the future ObserverOS authority required
Preview has no script, external URL, network primitive, form, business fixture, or source-field outside the approved labels
Verification proves the declared HTML boundaries
Typecheck, production build, control-plane validation, GitHub audit, and receipt pass
